docs.title: Projects

docs.title: 01: Heart Disease Exploratory Data Analysis
docs.text: Overview: This project explores the heart disease dataset to understand key health indicators and patterns related to disease presence. What was done: - Loaded and cleaned the dataset - Analyzed features including age, chest pain type, blood pressure, cholesterol, and exercise angina - Visualized relationships using charts and heatmaps - Interpreted correlations and trends to find patterns Key Insights: - Clinical features like chest pain type, max heart rate, and ST depression influence disease risk View Project →

docs.title: 02: Planets Data Exploratory Analysis
docs.text: Overview: Analyzing astronomical data for patterns in planetary measurements. What was done: - Visualized distributions of planetary attributes - Explored multivariate relationships using plots and summaries Key Insights: - Trends in orbital period, mass, and other features were highlighted View Project →

docs.title: 03: Student Performance Prediction
docs.text: Overview: Predictive modeling of student academic performance. What was done: - Explored dataset for performance predictors - Built ML models to predict grades/performance categories Key Takeaways: - Study time, attendance, and prior scores significantly influence performance View Project →

docs.title: 04: House Sales EDA & Modeling
docs.text: Overview: Analysis of house sales data with EDA and regression modeling to understand price drivers. What was done: - Data cleaning and preprocessing - Feature engineering to improve model performance - Built regression models to predict house prices Key Takeaways: - Identified influential features: location, square footage, condition - Optimized regression results after feature engineering View Project →

docs.title: 05: Venezuela Resource Dependency & Economy (1960-2023)
docs.text:
Overview: Analyzed Venezuela’s economic dependency on resources from 1960 to 2023. What was done: - Cleaned and visualized GDP, oil rents, fuel & metal exports - Conducted correlation and descriptive statistics Key Insights: - Resource dependency strongly impacts economic patterns - Time series trends highlight shifts in exports and GDP

View Project →

docs.title: 06: Image Classification Using Deep Learning
docs.text: Overview: Deep learning project for image classification. What was done: - Image data preprocessing - Built and trained convolutional neural network - Evaluated model performance using accuracy and loss metrics Key Insights: - Deep learning effectively recognizes patterns in images View Project →

docs.title: 07: Sentiment Analysis for Tweets
docs.text: Overview: Classifying sentiment in social media text. What was done: - Cleaned and preprocessed tweet text - Applied tokenization and vectorization - Built a classification model to predict sentiment Key Takeaways: - Model distinguishes positive, neutral, and negative tweets View Project →
